label: PF Backlog 613
title: EPIC: Generation proportionality & budget guardrails (artifact contracts: format/size/budget/slider/kind + enforcement)
body: Bounded-by-construction generation: each agent/stage is GIVEN its artifact format/sections, a size budget, a project-size slider, project-kind selection, required-vs-optional sections, counts, and structured schema validation; output is validated post-generation (fail-closed/compress, never truncate). Builds on the Artifact Contract Registry (PR #98).
